title: Genie One enhancements
body:
* **Ask Genie button hidden when unsupported**: In embedded dashboards, the **Ask Genie** button is now hidden when it isn't supported. See [Ask Genie in embedded dashboards](/aws/en/dashboards/share/embedding/basic#ask-genie).
* **Push notifications for scheduled tasks (Public Preview)**: The Genie mobile app can now send push notifications for scheduled tasks to iOS devices. See [Push notifications](/aws/en/genie-one/mobile#push-notifications).
